metadata.purpose: Practical claim register for the independently rebuilt Digi Tracks estate. Publication wording is deliberately narrower than source copy.

statusVocabulary.verified: Confirmed by a current local-source inspection, public source, or read-only HTTP measurement.
statusVocabulary.site-stated: Published by the estate but not independently proven beyond that statement.
statusVocabulary.unknown: Evidence is missing or the measurement was not performed.
statusVocabulary.retired: Previously asserted but no longer current.
statusVocabulary.contradicted: Current evidence conflicts with the claim.

sourceNotes: Portal and Learn claims use local source in /data/HomeWorks/DT-Portal-main plus live public HTTP.
SourceCraft, ProcureSherpa, LearnPMO and HCM Fusion claims use public pages and public JavaScript only.
No rights-reserved editorial content is copied into this register.
A licence text hash proves the identity of that text, not ownership of every asset or availability of product source.
UNKNOWN is retained for business identity, permissions, Search Console, WAF controls, accessibility conformance and field performance.

claims.subject: Estate route baseline
claims.claim: The six live sitemaps contain 384 unique URLs: portal 58, Learn 6, SourceCraft 139, ProcureSherpa 1, LearnPMO 12 and HCM Fusion 168.

evidence.detail: 58 unique URLs; all 58 document GETs returned 200.
6 unique URLs; all 6 document GETs returned 200.
139 unique URLs; all 139 document GETs returned 200.
1 unique URL; document GET returned 200.
12 unique URLs; all 12 document GETs returned 200.
168 unique URLs; all 168 document GETs returned 200.

claims.safePublicationWording: As measured on 25 November 2026, the six public sitemaps contained 384 URLs and every sitemap document returned HTTP 200.
claims.doNotSay: Do not describe 384 as the complete route surface; application, utility, evidence, export and hash-fragment routes are additional.

claims.subject: Portal catalogue
claims.claim: The portal catalogue contains 17 flagship products and 18 nested products, 35 in total.

evidence.detail: PRODUCTS contains 17 entries; UNIFY_MODULES 9, VEDIK_MODULES 4 and PROCURE5_SYSTEMS 5.
Explicit catalogue comment states 35 products.

claims.safePublicationWording: The current portal source defines a 35-product catalogue: 17 flagships and 18 nested products.
claims.doNotSay: Do not imply that all 35 are generally available, production-ready or open source.

claims.subject: Solutions and capability hubs
claims.claim: The portal defines six solution areas and two capability hubs.

evidence.detail: education, healthcare, beauty-wellness, business-operations, procurement and recruitment.
developer-tools and field-operations.

claims.safePublicationWording: The current portal organises solutions into six areas and two capability hubs.
claims.doNotSay: Do not turn solution categories into customer-outcome or industry-certification claims.

claims.subject: MIND ONE availability
claims.claim: MIND ONE is presented as pre-launch rather than a generally available proven product.

evidence.detail: Wait-state/pre-launch presentation.

claims.safePublicationWording: MIND ONE is currently presented as a pre-launch product with a wait-state journey.
claims.doNotSay: Do not claim production adoption, completed implementation or proven outcomes.

claims.subject: Pricing and buying model
claims.claim: Buying models are quote-led and no public numeric prices or payment links are configured in the portal source.

evidence.detail: PAYMENT_LINKS is empty; models distinguish freeware from open source.

claims.safePublicationWording: Pricing is quote-led. No public numeric price list or checkout is published in the current source.
claims.doNotSay: Do not invent numeric pricing, discounts, free tiers or checkout availability.

claims.subject: Customer proof
claims.claim: No genuine testimonials or customer case studies are present in the inspected portal source.

evidence.detail: TESTIMONIALS is an empty array.

claims.safePublicationWording: No customer testimonials or case studies are published in the current portal source.
claims.doNotSay: Do not fabricate quotes, logos, ratings, customer names, adoption figures or outcomes.

claims.subject: Business identity
claims.claim: Founder, legal entity, city/country, phone and studio-owned social profile are not established by the inspected source.

evidence.detail: Country is empty; only studio name and contact email are populated.

claims.safePublicationWording: The studio name and contact email are published; legal-entity, founder, location, phone and owned social-profile details remain unverified.
claims.doNotSay: Do not infer a legal entity, address, founder biography or corporate social account.

claims.subject: OpsPilot licence
claims.claim: The OpsPilot CLI package metadata identifies @ops_pilot/cli version 0.1.6 as Apache-2.0.

evidence.detail: OpsPilot Apache-2.0 and npm package reference.
Latest 0.1.6; licence Apache-2.0.

claims.safePublicationWording: The published OpsPilot CLI package is licensed under Apache-2.0.
claims.doNotSay: Do not extend the package licence to every Digi Tracks logo, screenshot, document or unrelated product.

claims.subject: Recon licence
claims.claim: Recon is proprietary/freeware, free to install for permitted internal executable use, and is not open source.

evidence.detail: Recon uses FREEWARE, not OPEN_SOURCE.
Proprietary Digi Tracks licence; SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE.
Latest 1.1.1; licence SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE.
Proprietary executable-use terms; no redistribution/source-access grant.

claims.safePublicationWording: Recon is free to install under a proprietary licence. It is not open source.
claims.doNotSay: Do not call Recon MIT, Apache, AGPL, source-available or redistributable.

claims.subject: Vantor licence, readiness and AI evidence
claims.claim: Public Vantor sources conflict with the official product page on licence, production readiness and AI citations.

evidence.detail: Site-stated AGPL-3.0-or-later and Ready to Deploy.
Official page states AGPL and that every AI answer is cited.
Repository states the software is not production-hardened and nothing in the portfolio is production-ready.
Repository licence file states Apache-2.0.
Implementation review found incomplete AI evidence references and pending real-model evaluation.

claims.safePublicationWording: Vantor is a public evaluation release. Published sources conflict on its licence, production readiness and AI citation behavior; owner confirmation is required before production use.
claims.doNotSay: Do not claim a definitive Vantor licence, production hardening, complete AI citations, OCR, verified semantic search, a named production ERP connector or MCP.

claims.subject: Orion availability
claims.claim: Orion is presented as a proprietary public preview.

evidence.detail: Proprietary public-preview wording.

claims.safePublicationWording: Orion is currently described as a proprietary public preview.
claims.doNotSay: Do not equate preview availability with production readiness or customer validation.

claims.subject: Chronos and Unify demos
claims.claim: Chronos and Unify demo access is gated in the current portal source.

evidence.detail: Demo request/gating fields.

claims.safePublicationWording: Chronos and Unify demos are request-gated.
claims.doNotSay: Do not publish ungated demo credentials or claim an always-available live demo.

claims.subject: SourceCraft licensing boundary
claims.claim: SourceCraft states that application code is MIT-licensed while term text, editorial notes and regional notes are all rights reserved.

evidence.detail: Explicit code/content licensing split; content marked (c) Digi Tracks, all rights reserved.

claims.safePublicationWording: SourceCraft's application code is described as MIT-licensed. Its term text and editorial/regional notes are all rights reserved and are not cleared for migration.
claims.doNotSay: Do not treat public crawlability or the MIT code statement as permission to copy terms, notes or diagrams.

claims.subject: SourceCraft content and editorial state
claims.claim: SourceCraft has 122 term pages and nine regional packs in its sitemap; the public Explore payload contains 122 records with status in_review and null reviewedAt values in the inspected records.

evidence.detail: 7 index/utility pages, 122 term pages and 10 region paths including the regional index.
122 occurrences of status in_review; pages emit index, follow.

claims.safePublicationWording: The 25 November 2026 snapshot contained 122 SourceCraft terms and nine regional packs; all inspected term records remained in editorial review.
claims.doNotSay: Do not describe every term as editor-approved or legally reviewed.

claims.subject: SourceCraft favourites route
claims.claim: The previously reported broken /favourites/ route returned HTTP 200 and noindex on 25 November 2026.

evidence.detail: 200; title Saved terms | Source Craft; canonical /favourites/; robots noindex, follow.
200 with the same response bytes; no redirect.

claims.safePublicationWording: The saved-terms route responded successfully during the 25 November 2026 audit.
claims.doNotSay: Do not repeat the earlier 404 as a current defect; browser persistence behavior was not executed.

claims.subject: ProcureSherpa privacy and state
claims.claim: ProcureSherpa states that it has no accounts, no server-side storage and no telemetry, and keeps state in browser localStorage.

evidence.detail: Public privacy/source statements; no browser-state or network parity test performed.

claims.safePublicationWording: ProcureSherpa is presented as a local-first browser application with browser-stored state and no account or telemetry requirement.
claims.doNotSay: Do not claim independently verified absence of all network calls or production parity without authorized source and testing.

claims.subject: ProcureSherpa route model
claims.claim: Public source defines 506 unique typed hash-content routes: 393 library records, 94 academy functions and 19 calculators.

evidence.detail: 393 typed records; 390 unique IDs; duplicate IDs occur in different type namespaces.
19 inline PS_CALC definitions.
PS.routeFor and PS.TYPE_ROUTE produce typed paths.

claims.safePublicationWording: The inspected public source defines 506 typed client-side content routes. The document shell returned 200; individual fragment rendering was not executed.
claims.doNotSay: Do not report 503 unique routes; that earlier figure ignored the type namespace of three duplicate IDs.

claims.subject: LearnPMO known page surface
claims.claim: LearnPMO has 12 sitemap pages, 20 additional linked application/workspace paths and a root redirect to /dashboard, giving 33 known page paths including root.

evidence.detail: 12 URLs, all 200.
20 additional public links.
307 Location /dashboard.

claims.safePublicationWording: The audit identified 33 LearnPMO page paths including the root redirect; the 12 sitemap pages all returned 200.
claims.doNotSay: Do not claim authenticated workflows, cloud sync, backup/import parity or tenant isolation were tested.

claims.subject: HCM Fusion reading-library counts
claims.claim: The HCM Fusion sitemap contains 47 lesson pages, 70 concept pages and 26 glossary pages.

evidence.detail: Exact route-family counts; all 168 URLs returned 200.

claims.safePublicationWording: The 25 November 2026 sitemap contained 47 lessons, 70 concepts and 26 glossary entries.
claims.doNotSay: Do not confuse sitemap counts with the site's separate planned/published module totals or claim editorial approval.

claims.subject: HCM Fusion evidence register
claims.claim: There are 371 publicly linked evidence-claim pages; the site's source register separately states 446 claims, 441 verified claims and five open gaps.

evidence.detail: 371 unique /evidence/claims/<ID> links; all measured 200.
Site-stated totals: 178 sources, 446 claims, 441 verified and five gaps.

claims.safePublicationWording: The public crawl exposed 371 evidence pages. The site's internal register states 446 claims; the two totals have different scopes and require owner reconciliation.
claims.doNotSay: Do not claim all 446 claims are publicly accessible, editorially approved or migration-cleared.

claims.subject: HCM Fusion additional public families
claims.claim: Beyond the sitemap, HCM Fusion exposes 464 known paths: 371 evidence claims, 47 assessments, four certification papers, three SOPs, two scenarios, 27 exports, three unsitemapped courses and seven application/user paths.

evidence.detail: 462 additional paths found from all sitemap pages plus public indexes.
/profile and /progress add two known paths named in robots/source evidence.

claims.safePublicationWording: The audit identified 464 additional HCM Fusion paths outside the sitemap; their current indexability policy is inconsistent and is not automatically approved for the replacement.
claims.doNotSay: Do not call all additional routes indexable, authenticated, safe to migrate or complete.

claims.subject: HCM Fusion course coverage statements
claims.claim: The course catalogue states 12 modules, 47 of 156 lessons published, five published modules, four in production and three planned, while only nine course pages are in the sitemap.

evidence.detail: Coverage wording.
Nine course-detail pages.

claims.safePublicationWording: The current catalogue describes partial coverage: 47 of 156 planned lessons. Module-status totals require owner reconciliation.
claims.doNotSay: Do not describe HCM Fusion as a complete 156-lesson or 12-module published course.

claims.subject: HCM Fusion configuration-order count
claims.claim: The lesson and exports say seven setup steps but enumerate six configuration actions; decision nodes and the terminal route are separate displayed items.

evidence.detail: Seven setup steps wording; six actions plus decision/terminal display nodes.
Repeats seven-step wording while listing six actions.

claims.safePublicationWording: The inspected configuration-order content contains six configuration actions and additional decision/terminal nodes; its seven-step label is inconsistent.
claims.doNotSay: Do not publish an unqualified seven-step count until the owner approves the corrected model.

claims.subject: HCM Fusion assessment integrity
claims.claim: At least one assessment's serialized public payload exposes correct-answer keys, correctness flags, rationales and correct ordering before submission.

evidence.detail: RSC payload includes isCorrect, key and rationale fields plus correctOrder; 12 isCorrect occurrences in the inspected four-question payload.

claims.safePublicationWording: The inspected assessment payload exposes answer material before submission and requires remediation before reuse.
claims.doNotSay: Do not claim secure assessment scoring or answer confidentiality.

claims.subject: HCM Fusion export diagram totals
claims.claim: All nine Markdown module exports state that 53 diagrams are included, while the 27 exports contain 51 diagram/figure descriptions per format across nine modules.

evidence.detail: 27 paths returned 200. HTML <figure>, Markdown Diagram headings and text Diagram headings each total 51.
States 53 diagrams; Core HR contains eight.

claims.safePublicationWording: The export set currently contains 51 diagram descriptions, not the 53 stated in each Markdown export.
claims.doNotSay: Do not publish 53 as a verified diagram count.

claims.subject: Portal lead delivery
claims.claim: The current portal/Learn worker sends email directly and does not implement durable D1/outbox/queue/CRM-webhook delivery semantics.

evidence.detail: Routes /api/send-email and /api/lead; direct email delivery.
Forms send to the studio inbox; no durable CRM claim.

claims.safePublicationWording: The current source notifies the studio inbox by email. Durable queued delivery and CRM webhook receipt have not been demonstrated.
claims.doNotSay: Do not tell visitors a lead reached an inbox or CRM until staging proves delivery; no live form POST was performed.

claims.subject: Portal bot verification and rate limiting
claims.claim: Turnstile is optional and was not active in the inspected live CSP; source notes that the Cloudflare Rate Limiting binding did not enforce in live testing.

evidence.detail: Optional widget/secret; logs off; per-isolate memory limits; owner-managed WAF rule.
Optional Turnstile origins.
Live CSP contains no Turnstile host.

claims.safePublicationWording: Bot verification is configurable but was not active in the inspected live configuration. Rate limiting relies on compensating controls whose production enforcement is not proven.
claims.doNotSay: Do not claim verified bot protection, enforceable rate limits or an inspected WAF configuration.

claims.subject: Hosting boundary
claims.claim: Portal and Learn are served through Cloudflare; SourceCraft, ProcureSherpa, LearnPMO and HCM Fusion report Vercel.

evidence.detail: Server headers: Cloudflare for 64 sitemap URLs and Vercel for 320.

claims.safePublicationWording: The current estate spans two hosting platforms: Cloudflare for portal/Learn and Vercel for the four application hosts.
claims.doNotSay: Do not imply a single deployment boundary or shared origin state.

claims.subject: Estate metadata coverage
claims.claim: Across 384 sitemap URLs, 65 have JSON-LD and 181 lack OG/Twitter images; all have canonicals and exactly one H1 except ProcureSherpa's initial shell.

evidence.detail: JSON-LD: portal 58, Learn 6, ProcureSherpa 1. Missing social images: ProcureSherpa 1, LearnPMO 12, HCM Fusion 168.

claims.safePublicationWording: The 25 November 2026 crawl found complete canonical coverage, partial structured-data coverage and missing social imagery on 181 sitemap URLs.
claims.doNotSay: Do not claim every URL needs JSON-LD or that metadata presence proves rich-result eligibility.

claims.subject: Implemented self-hosted fonts
claims.claim: The replacement uses self-hosted Host Grotesk Variable and Instrument Serif under SIL OFL 1.1, plus a system monospace stack; Inter is not used.

evidence.detail: @fontsource-variable/host-grotesk 5.3.0 and @fontsource/instrument-serif 5.3.0.
Two font records with hashes and OFL provenance.
Maximum measured font transfer 42,424 B per template.

claims.safePublicationWording: The replacement self-hosts Host Grotesk and Instrument Serif under their open-font licences and uses a system monospace stack; Inter is not used.
claims.doNotSay: Do not describe local automated measurements as field-performance proof or omit retained font-licence evidence.

claims.subject: Approved identity and asset provenance
claims.claim: The replacement uses 40 owner-supplied identity assets plus two documented 320px lockup derivatives, including 33 unique official product marks; no official MIND ONE or MIND ONE Pro mark was supplied.

evidence.detail: 42 identity records with source/destination hashes and permitted use.
Seven master identity/icon assets and 33 unique official WebP product marks.
Rendered official marks and responsive lockup measurements.

claims.safePublicationWording: The replacement uses the supplied Digi Tracks identity and official product marks with recorded provenance. MIND ONE retains a neutral identifier because no official mark was supplied.
claims.doNotSay: Do not call generated product identifiers official logos or claim approval for assets beyond the supplied and recorded identity set.

claims.subject: stats.digitracks.net
claims.claim: The stats origin is non-indexable and returned HTTP 520 during the audit.
claims.safePublicationWording: The non-indexable stats origin was unavailable with HTTP 520 and is excluded from the replacement scope.
claims.doNotSay: Do not include it as a seventh public replacement target.

claims.subject: Search, WAF and analytics operations
claims.claim: Search Console acceptance, IndexNow submission, analytics property access and production WAF configuration are not established by the evidence.

evidence.source: Approved audit brief and local source comments
evidence.detail: No owner credentials or operator evidence supplied.

claims.safePublicationWording: Search Console, IndexNow, analytics access and WAF controls remain owner-verification items.
claims.doNotSay: Do not claim search acceptance, indexing completion, analytics deployment or WAF enforcement.

claims.subject: Replacement accessibility and performance evidence
claims.claim: The final replacement has local automated accessibility, responsive and Lighthouse evidence, but WCAG conformance, field Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse INP and full device/assistive-technology behavior remain unproven.

evidence.detail: 40 desktop/mobile checks, zero axe violations and zero browser-health failures.
86 routes and 344 states across 1440/1024/768/390 widths.
Six rebuilt origins score 98–100 performance; INP is null.

claims.safePublicationWording: The replacement passes the recorded local automated accessibility and performance gates. These results do not prove WCAG conformance, field Core Web Vitals or production behavior.
claims.doNotSay: Do not claim WCAG 2.2 AA conformance, measured INP, field p75 performance or universal device coverage.

claims.subject: Rights-reserved content migration
claims.claim: No owner permission was supplied to migrate SourceCraft terms/notes or HCM Fusion lessons, concepts, glossary, evidence, assessments, procedures, scenarios or diagrams.

evidence.detail: Content explicitly all rights reserved.
Public crawlability is not redistribution permission.

claims.safePublicationWording: Rights-reserved content migration is blocked pending written owner permission and editorial approval.
claims.doNotSay: Do not copy rights-reserved content into the new project or infer permission from public availability.

claims.subject: Application parity and authorized source
claims.claim: Authorized source/data for ProcureSherpa, LearnPMO and HCM Fusion application behavior, state schemas, roles and scoring rules were not supplied.

evidence.detail: Canonical application source/data is a required owner input and stop condition.

claims.safePublicationWording: Authenticated/application parity remains blocked until authorized source, schemas and rules are supplied and tested.
claims.doNotSay: Do not simulate real accounts, scoring, tenant isolation or demo data as production behavior.

claims.subject: MIND ONE scope and editions
claims.claim: MIND ONE is vendor-stated as a pre-launch interview-practice product, with Free entry and complete Pro positioning but no approved edition entitlement table.

evidence.detail: Official scope, pre-launch state, Free/Pro positioning and no published launch date.
Portfolio lists MINDONE as Up Next; no implementation repository was verified.

claims.safePublicationWording: MIND ONE is a pre-launch interview-practice product. Free and Pro positioning is published, but Pro entitlements, price and release timing require confirmation.
claims.doNotSay: Do not claim release availability, a launch date, measured outcomes, Pro-only features, ATS integration, MCP or verified multilingual speech.

claims.subject: Vedik demonstration scope
claims.claim: Vedik's public School ERP demo is code-backed and uses mock data; production backend, wider application behavior and a settled module count are unverified.

evidence.detail: Static route, plan and module definitions inspected read-only.
School ERP demo shows mock-data school operations and a different module total from the repository README.
Vendor describes the wider education-platform family.

claims.safePublicationWording: Vedik's public School ERP demo shows role-based school operations with sample data. Production deployment and the wider application family require evaluation.
claims.doNotSay: Do not claim a settled module count, all four applications are code-backed, production-ready offline/mobile behavior or unverified integrations.

claims.subject: Nipuna recruiting scope
claims.claim: Nipuna's public description covers local-first résumé intake, OCR, deterministic rule-based matching and hiring pipelines; implementation and accuracy are unverified.

evidence.detail: Vendor-stated local parsing, OCR, rule-based matching, candidate scoring, pipelines and token-linked questionnaires.

claims.safePublicationWording: Nipuna is presented as a local-first recruiting toolkit with deterministic candidate matching. Request a deployment assessment.
claims.doNotSay: Do not claim generative-AI matching, measured accuracy, verified ATS integration, MCP or independently proven production readiness.

claims.subject: Vertex showcase and production boundary
claims.claim: Vertex's public showcase demonstrates procurement and project workflows with fictional data; production implementation and edition entitlements remain unverified.

evidence.detail: Showcase explicitly labels its data fictional and demonstrates requisition-to-invoice and sealed RFQ flows.
Vendor describes local deployment, approvals and three-way matching.

claims.safePublicationWording: Vertex's public showcase demonstrates procurement and project workflows with fictional data. Request a production evaluation.
claims.doNotSay: Do not claim the showcase proves production parity, live integrations, AI, MCP or verified edition entitlements.

claims.subject: Procure Sherpa and ProcureSherpa Learning scope
claims.claim: Procure Sherpa is a free browser-based learning and decision-support toolkit; ProcureSherpa Learning is its Academy component, not a verified separate product.

evidence.detail: Current client implements local state, Academy progress, calculators, saved work, document-pack printing and local retrieval.
Content registrations and local retrieval/citation behavior inspected read-only.
Academy, calculators, SOP, checklist and decision-support documentation.

claims.safePublicationWording: Procure Sherpa is a free browser-based procurement learning and decision-support toolkit. ProcureSherpa Learning names its Academy component.
claims.doNotSay: Do not claim procurement ERP behavior, accredited credentials, native PDF generation, custom workflows, team administration, generative AI, MCP or a verified current offline PWA.
